messages:
Maria: Quick preflight — pushing v2026-03-17. Deploy window 22:00 UTC, quiet window 22:00–23:00. Need: rollback matrix ack, smoke owner, DB migration owner, canary plan. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/deploy-2026-03-17
Jon: I can own smoke checks (API + frontend). I'll run through the smoke checklist at -5m and +10m.
Priya: I own DB migration. Note: migration is online, forwards+backwards compatible but there is a short index build. I'll throttle it. If index build exceeds 8m, we rollback.
Ryan: Rollback criteria proposal: any of these -> 1) sustained error rate >2% for 5m, 2) tail latency p95 increase >1.5x baseline for 3m, 3) failed migrations or missing feature flags, 4) significant quality regression on canary prompts. Agree?
Emily: +1 on criteria. Add: SLO alert for request size spikes. Also confirm the exact rollback command.
Katie: Rollback command is in the runbook. Quick snippet we tested in staging:
```bash
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/infer-server infer-server=redwood/infer:v2026-03-09-rollback
# confirm pods restarted
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/infer-server
```
Maria: Canary plan — 10% traffic for 15m, if green -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. If any canary signal triggers, immediate rollback to 0% and revert image. deploy-bot will post canary metrics in thread.
deploy-bot: Canary started on infer-cluster-a (10% traffic). Metrics: 0.3% errors so far, p95 latency 280ms. :dart:
Jon: I'll post smoke checklist results at T+5m. Will run curl + synthetic traces.
Priya: DB migration will start at T+2m, monitor index build time. On long build I will toggle migration.pause in the migration service and request rollback.
Ryan: Contact list: Maria (release), Jon (smoke), Priya (DB), Emily (rollback ops), Ops on-call (pager). If someone's offline, escalate to on-call.
Emily: I tested rollback path — note that cache warmup takes ~3m after rollback. Signal thresholds need to account for that.
Maria: Acks: @Jon, @Priya, @Emily, @Ryan — please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept ownership and criteria.
Jon: :white_check_mark:
Priya: :white_check_mark:
Emily: :white_check_mark:
Ryan: :white_check_mark:
Maria: Great — proceeding with deploy. Will post final 'GO' 10m before window. Keep phone on. :phone:
